Emma (Docs): Hey @Sam (Eng) @Maria (PM) — PR #482 (docs/netlify-link-fix) is ready for review but Netlify preview is returning 404s for several asset links. Can one of you take a quick look? Preview: https://deploy-preview-482--redwood-docs.netlify.app

ci-bot: Netlify build failed: step=build:css status=error
Error: Can't resolve './assets/logo.svg' in /app/site/src/components

devx-bot: Preview created: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/65ab12f — build log attached in the deploy UI

Sam (Eng): I can take a look in ~30m. Quick Q: did you test with local production build (`pnpm docs:build`) or only dev server?

Emma (Docs): I tested with `pnpm docs:dev` and it looked fine. I also tried `pnpm docs:build` locally and it produced the site directory without errors. Looks like Netlify resolves the base path differently (relative imports).

Maria (PM): We need this merged before Monday's AMA. If it's just a path fix, please prioritize.

Sam (Eng): Two common causes: (1) relative imports in CSS/js that assume current dir, (2) Netlify "publish" path mismatch. Can you paste the failing import?

Emma (Docs): The failing import in the log: `url("./assets/logo.svg")` inside `Header.module.css`. I changed it to `url("/assets/logo.svg")` in the PR but Netlify still saw the old cache on first deploy.

Sam (Eng): Can you try clearing Netlify cache (force a new deploy) or switch to absolute CDN path for that asset as a quick fix?

Emma (Docs): I'll try CDN. Quick local commands I'm using for reproduction:
```
pnpm install
pnpm docs:build  # produces site/
npx serve site -l 9000
```
Works locally, fails on Netlify.

devx-bot: Note: you can also run `npx netlify-cli build` to emulate Netlify build environment locally.

Emma (Docs): Thanks — tried `npx netlify-cli build`, reproduced the error. Pushed an update to switch that import to `https://cdn.redwood.com/docs/assets/logo.svg` in the PR. Triggering a new deploy now.

devx-bot: New deploy triggered: https://deploy-preview-482--redwood-docs.netlify.app (build queued)

ci-bot: Deploy status: in_progress — build step: installing dependencies

ci-bot: Deploy status: success — build duration 1m42s. All Netlify checks passed.

Sam (Eng): I reviewed the PR diff. The CDN link is fine as a short-term fix but we should follow up to make asset imports consistent. Approving now. :+1:

Maria (PM): Approved from product side. Please merge during a low-traffic window.

Sam (Eng): I'll merge at 21:00 UTC to avoid morning US noise unless Emma wants it sooner.

Emma (Docs): 21:00 UTC works for me. Thanks everyone. I'll add a follow-up ticket to standardize asset imports and update the docs build guide with `npx netlify-cli build` instructions.

devx-bot: Merge performed by Sam (Eng) at 1750007000 (21:00 UTC). Production deploy queued: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/66cd34a

ci-bot: Production deploy succeeded. Site is live.

Emma (Docs): Merged and confirmed live. Huge thanks :tada: 

Maria (PM): Awesome — cheers team!

Sam (Eng): Follow-up: I'll open a short RFC on assets + netlify config.

Emma (Docs): I'll add the local preview snippet to the contributor guide: `npx netlify-cli build` + `serve site`.

devx-bot: Reminder: tag PRs that change build infra with `infra/docs` label so CI owns triage.
